title: ScheduleUpdateInput
description: Change one of the schedules you set: only the fields given change, and the next run is worked out again from now. enabled=false pauses it, true resumes it. Switching between one-off and recurring: give at / in_minutes or cron.

schedule_id.description: The schedule's id (sc_…), from schedule_create or schedule_list.

at.description: One-off: fire once at this time (ISO 8601 with an offset, e.g. 2026-11-23T09:00:00+08:00), 1 minute to 30 days from now.

in_minutes.description: One-off: fire once this many minutes from now.

cron.description: Recurring: five cron fields (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5") or a descriptor (@daily, @every 2h), read in timezone; at least 5 minutes between runs.

timezone.description: IANA zone the cron is read in (e.g. Asia/Shanghai, the user's zone when you know it); default UTC.

max_runs.description: Recurring: stop after this many runs.
